name: Vikravandi–Manamadurai Highway
aka: Formed from the former NH 45C and NH 226
history: NH 36 runs across the middle of Tamil Nadu, from Vikravandi on the Chennai–Trichy highway down to Manamadurai near Madurai. It was formed by joining two older highways, NH 45C and NH 226, into one number. On the way it crosses the green Cauvery delta and links the famous temple towns of Kumbakonam and Thanjavur.
facts: Formed by joining the old NH 45C (Vikravandi–Thanjavur) and NH 226 (Thanjavur–Manamadurai).
Passes through the Cauvery delta, often called Tamil Nadu's rice bowl.
Thanjavur's Brihadisvara Temple, just off this road, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
About 334 km long, entirely inside Tamil Nadu.
